checks: Apply the customer’s chosen pickup mode to the observed partial inventory and distinguish delayed release from partial release or cancellation. Independent blind solve and item-level English, Traditional Chinese, answer and each distractor verified after language corrections.

activeQuestion.prompt: The portal lists orders as pending until it sends a collection notice. If the customer requests a single pickup, both cartons must be counted before any notice is sent; otherwise, a notice can go out for either carton. One of Jae’s two cartons has been counted, and he requested a single pickup. His order should ____.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 入口網站在發出取貨通知前，會把訂單列為待處理。若顧客要求一次取貨，兩箱都完成清點後才能發出任何通知；否則，可以先為其中一箱發通知。Jae 的兩箱貨中已有一箱清點完畢，而他要求一次取貨。他的訂單應該____。

options.text: remain pending until the second carton is counted
options.zh: 等第二箱清點完畢前，維持待處理
options.whyZh: 要求一次取貨時，必須等兩箱都清點完才能通知。現在只有一箱完成，因此整筆訂單仍在等待。

options.text: show one carton as ready to collect
options.zh: 顯示其中一箱可先取貨
options.whyZh: 只清點一箱即可通知的做法只適用未要求一次取貨的訂單；Jae 要求一次取貨。

options.text: be cancelled because one carton is missing
options.whyZh: 第二箱尚未清點，不代表遺失；規則要求等待清點，不是取消。

options.text: show both cartons as ready because one has been counted
options.zh: 因有一箱清點完畢，就顯示兩箱可取貨
options.whyZh: 清點一箱無法滿足兩箱都須清點的條件；不能提前標註整單可取貨。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 要求一次取貨時，必須等兩箱都清點完才能通知。現在只有一箱完成，因此整筆訂單仍在等待。

options.whyZh: 形容人的態度，意思也不合。
